summary: Business Clarity module testing complete - All 26 backend tests pass, all frontend tabs and reports working correctly. Fixed 2 bugs: datetime comparison issue in dashboard and NoneType error in event profitability report.
seed_data_creation: Test invoices and payments created during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Business Clarity module fully tested. All endpoints working: Dashboard, Invoices, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payments, Stripe Checkout, and all 4 Executive Reports. Two bugs were fixed during testing.

bug_1.issue: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'float' and 'NoneType' in event profitability report
bug_1.fix: Changed `item.get('internal_cost', 0)` to `item.get('internal_cost') or 0` to handle None values

bug_2.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes in dashboard endpoint
bug_2.fix: Added parse_due_date() helper function to safely parse datetime strings and MongoDB datetime objects with proper timezone handling

backend_endpoints.GET /api/business-clarity/dashboard: PASS - Returns KPIs (receivables, overdue, payables, aging)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/business-clarity/invoices: PASS - Returns invoice list with filters
backend_endpoints.GET /api/business-clarity/accounts-recei: PASS - Returns A/R with aging buckets

frontend_tabs.Dashboard: PASS - Shows KPI cards, aging analysis chart, recent payments
frontend_tabs.Invoices: PASS - Shows invoice table with status filter and checkbox selection
frontend_tabs.Receivables: PASS - Shows A/R summary, aging buckets, and records table
frontend_tabs.Payables: PASS - Shows A/P summary and records table
frontend_tabs.Reports: PASS - Shows Financial Snapshot, Client Revenue, Supplier Spend, Event Profitability sub-tabs

stripe_integration_note: Stripe checkout endpoint requires valid invoice_ids with balance due. Test with empty invoice_ids correctly returns 400 error. Full Stripe flow not tested as it requires actual invoices with balance.
